raw_event: Employee signed in to the sales workstation after office hours.
Customer account export was opened from the internal sales share.
Pricing workbook was opened from the same internal share.
Archive utility started to package the two sales files.
Temporary archive containing sales exports was created.
Archive utility opened an encrypted connection to an unapproved file-sharing address.
Large upload of the sales archive was recorded to the unapproved address.
Temporary sales archive was deleted from the workstation after upload.
Employee session ended after the transfer.
